cases.name: Rosaly Cindy Shavarria Rodriguez
cases.about: She was a native of Peru and at the Wilderness Resort in Wisconsin.
cases.narrative: On 10/14/2020, her heavily decomposed emains were found in a purple suitcase on an abandoned farm along County Highway T in the Town of Wheaton, MO, 150 miles from the area where she lived. It took nearly another year for her to be positively identified.
